breakpoints.note: Source. While parsing the attacker-controlled `%.4294629629s` field, `mrb_str_format()` invokes `get_num()` on the decimal precision digits so they become vulnerability-relevant numeric state in `prec`.

Root cause fixed by the patch. `get_num()` narrows the parsed decimal value from `mrb_int next_n` into 32-bit `int` without first checking whether it fits in `INT_MAX`, so oversized numeric format specifiers become negative `prec`/`width` values instead of being rejected.

AddressSanitizer crash site. `mrb_str_format()` passes the negative `len` derived from the malformed precision into `PUSH`, whose macro expansion reaches `memcpy(&buf[blen], s, l)` with `l < 0` and triggers the saved `negative-size-param` abort.
